Dự án khu biệt thự trên bán đảo Sơn Trà: The villa project on Son Tra Peninsula had its zoning approved in 2011 and adjusted in 2014, but for many years it was never fully implemented and came under review following inspection conclusions. In early May 2026, the Son Tra Ward People's Committee consulted the local community on canceling this 1/500 detailed zoning plan (reported by Tuoi Tre on May 8, 2026). Before that, the city had also revoked land boundary approvals for several unimplemented projects on the peninsula.
